build_CLIP_model_from_state_dict: build a CLIP model from a PyTorch state dict using the build_model function
encode_image_with_CLIP: encode an image tensor into features using the CLIP encode_image method
encode_text_with_CLIP: encode text tokens into features using the CLIP encode_text method
run_CLIP_forward_pass: run a CLIP forward pass with image and text to get similarity logits
convert_model_weights_to_fp16: convert CLIP model weights to fp16 using the convert_weights function
